prior_suggestions.start_name: National gas-grid take-off point, New Damietta industrial zone, Damietta Governorate, Egypt (exact node/station not named in the available source)
prior_suggestions.end_name: SEGAS LNG plant / Union Fenosa Gas (فيونسا) gas intake & metering station, New Damietta, Damietta Governorate, Egypt
prior_suggestions.corridor_desc: GEM's sheet records identical Start and End location values ('Damietta'/'Damietta'), consistent with this being a short ~12km 'duplication' (إزدواج, i.e. a parallel/looping pipe added alongside an existing line to add capacity) entirely within the New Damietta industrial zone, rather than a route between two distinct named cities. The one named, coordinate-sourced anchor is the SEGAS LNG / Union Fenosa Gas intake and metering chamber (also serving the adjacent Egyptian Methanex methanol plant) at approx. 31.4677N, 31.7691E (Wikidata Q7389666; corroborated by en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SEGAS_LNG and offshore-technology.com, which place the complex in New Damietta ~60km west of Port Said). The other end — the actual take-off point on the existing national grid that this line duplicates/parallels — is not named in the available source; by analogy with the related Gamasa–Fenosa line (P6035), which taps 'room 10 on the Idku–Damietta 32in line' before reaching the same Fenosa/Methanex intake chamber, this duplication line likely originates from a nearby metering/take-off point on the existing Damietta-area grid (Idku–Damietta corridor or a GASCO reduction station in/near New Damietta), but that specific node is NOT independently confirmed for THIS project and is not asserted as fact. Treat the corridor as bounded to a several-km radius around the SEGAS/Methanex industrial complex in New Damietta until a human sources the exact take-off point.

prior_suggestions.start_name: Gamasa (station/room #10 on the Edco–Damietta 32" trunk), Dakahlia/Damietta coast
prior_suggestions.end_name: Finusa (Veunsa) intake feeding the West Damietta power plant, Kafr Saad, Damietta
prior_suggestions.corridor_desc: ~34 km trunk spur running NE along the Nile Delta Mediterranean-coast belt from the Gamasa tie-in (station #10 on the existing Edco–Damietta 32" line, ~31.145N 31.513E, on the Dakahlia coast) to the Finusa/Veunsa intake at the West Damietta (New West Damietta) power plant near Kafr Saad, Damietta Governorate (~31.442N 31.606E). Straight-line distance between these two named endpoints is ~33 km, matching the documented 34 km length, so the corridor is tightly bounded even without routed geometry. Intermediate routing (the actual pipe alignment across the coastal farmland/lagoon fringe of Dakahlia–Damietta) is not published; endpoints are firm, path is inferred.
